people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.
translations.bsb: The workers of the city who cultivate it will come from all the tribes of Israel.
translations.kjv: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
translations.asv: And they that labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall till it.
